req.title: Task description optional
req.statement: The system shall accept POST /tasks/ payloads without a description field.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the task description field is optional when creating a task. We need to ensure that the system correctly handles requests with and without this field, and that it responds appropriately to malformed requests.

tests.name: test_create_task_without_description
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a payload that omits the description field.
expected: The response payload contains the task with the correct title and default completed status.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "New Task"})
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == "New Task"
assert response.json()["description"] is None
assert response.json()["completed"] is False

tests.name: test_create_task_with_invalid_payload
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a payload missing the required title field.
expected: The response contains a validation error message indicating the missing title field.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"description": "Task without title"})
assert response.status_code == 422
assert "title" in response.json()["detail"][0]["loc"]

tests.name: test_create_task_with_max_title_length
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a title field of exactly 100 characters.
expected: The response payload contains the task with the correct title and default completed status.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

max_length_title = "T" * 100
response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": max_length_title})
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == max_length_title
assert response.json()["description"] is None
assert response.json()["completed"] is False
